turns.customer: One of the two Beacon 500 headlamps from order #1245 stopped charging after a 3-night trip. Can I return it?
turns.reply: Because the headlamp stopped working after use, it is not eligible for a standard return. However, it may be covered by the one-year warranty if it is a manufacturing defect from normal use. I have escalated this to a human team member for review (Ticket ESC-52), and someone will follow up with you by email, usually within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
